backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (UserProfile, Video, CarMeet, DirectMessage, etc.) and including MixinStorage and MixinAuthorization mixins with a hardcoded admin principal and role-based access control helpers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that TypeScript compilation errors in the React frontend were audited and fixed across hooks, components, and pages to ensure a successful Vite build.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose, key fixes, and design decisions for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file that imports Tailwind layers and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the Vite app titled 'RevReel' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router tree with all application routes under a shared layout, and renders ProfileSetupModal with required open/onComplete props when an authenticated user has no profile.
frontend/src/components/AftermarketAdBan: Sponsored banner component linking to an eBay affiliate URL, displaying an aftermarket car parts ad image with an overlay gradient and CTA text.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Wrapper component that shows a loading spinner during initialization, a neon-styled login prompt when unauthenticated, or renders children when the user is logged in.
frontend/src/components/CarMeetCard.tsx: Card component for a car meet that displays location, date, and attendee count, and provides attend/leave toggle buttons using the useJoinMeet/useLeaveMeet mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/ChallengeModal.t: A modal dialog component that allows a user to send a video challenge to another user by entering their video ID, using the `usePostChallenge` mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/CommentsPanel.ts: A slide-over panel that displays and allows adding comments for a given video, fetching comments via `useGetComments` and posting via `useAddComment`, requiring authentication to submit.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: A modal dialog for editing a user's profile, supporting username, bio, and avatar image updates via the `useUpdateProfile` mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/FollowButton.tsx: A button component that toggles following/unfollowing a user based on the current follower list, using `useFollowUser` and `useUnfollowUser` hooks.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main app layout component rendering a bottom navigation bar with static nav items, a dynamic profile link, and a 'More' sheet overlay for additional navigation destinations.
frontend/src/components/PostIssueModal.t: A modal dialog for posting a car mechanic issue with title, category, and description fields, submitting via the `useCreateMechanicsPost` mutation and requiring authentication.
frontend/src/components/PostListingModal: Modal dialog for creating a new parts/car listing with fields for title, make, model, year, price, condition, category, image URL, and description, using the useCreateListing mutation.
frontend/src/components/PostMeetModal.ts: Modal dialog for creating a new car meet event with fields for title, location, date/time, category, and description, using the useCreateCarMeet mutation.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Onboarding modal that collects a username and bio to create an initial UserProfile, saving it via the useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation and blocking dismissal until complete.
frontend/src/components/StartBuildLogMod: Modal dialog for starting a new build log with fields for title, car make/model/year, and description, using the useCreateBuildLog mutation.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Full-screen video/photo card component with play/pause, mute, like (optimistic update), share, and comments panel functionality, auto-playing when the card is active.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks (queries and mutations) for all backend interactions including user profiles, videos, comments, direct messages, build logs, and admin operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Barlow fonts, configures Tailwind CSS, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark theming, and adds utility classes for neon effects and glassmorphism.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Static About page for RevReel that displays the platform's hero section, description, feature list, and social/donation links with a car-enthusiast theme.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only page that lists all users and allows deletion, showing an access-denied state for non-admins and loading spinners during data fetching.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogDetails.tsx: Detail page for a single build log that displays its stages, allows the author to add new stages via a form, and provides a delete confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogs.tsx: Displays a list of user build logs with loading skeletons and an empty state, allowing authenticated users to create new builds via a modal. Injects an ad banner after every 4th log entry.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeetDetails.tsx: Shows detailed information for a single car meet including location, date, category, and attendees, with join/leave functionality for authenticated users. Handles loading and not-found states.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeets.tsx: Lists all car meets with loading skeletons and an empty state, allowing authenticated users to post new meets via a modal. Injects an ad banner after every 4th meet card.
frontend/src/pages/Classifieds.tsx: Displays active classified listings with images, car details, price, and condition, linking to individual listing pages. Injects an ad banner at the top and after every 4th listing.
frontend/src/pages/Conversation.tsx: Renders a direct message conversation between the current user and another user, with real-time-style message display, send functionality, and auto-scroll to the latest message.
frontend/src/pages/Discover.tsx: Provides a search interface for videos by title, hashtag, or category, and displays category buttons and trending hashtags when no search query is active.
frontend/src/pages/Feed.tsx: Displays a vertically scrollable, snap-scrolling feed of all videos sorted by newest first, using IntersectionObserver to track the active video and pass it to VideoCard.
frontend/src/pages/FilteredFeed.tsx: Same snap-scroll video feed as Feed.tsx but filters videos by category or hashtag from URL search params, with a back-navigation header.
frontend/src/pages/Inbox.tsx: Shows a tabbed inbox page with conversation summaries and a list of followed users, allowing navigation to individual conversation threads; requires authentication.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with hero section and Internet Identity login; clears any persisted session on load and redirects authenticated users to the feed.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Displays top 10 trending videos by view count and top 10 uploaders by total views, with an ad banner between sections.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetails.tsx: Shows full details of a single classifieds listing including image, price, and seller profile, with a deactivate option for the listing owner.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsHelp.tsx: Displays a list of community mechanics help posts with loading skeletons, empty state, and periodic ad banners. Includes a button to open a modal for posting new issues.
Shows the full details of a single mechanics help post including its description, comments/replies, and a reply form. Post authors can delete their post, and authenticated users can add comments.
frontend/src/pages/Notifications.tsx: Renders a list of user notifications with read/unread states, supporting marking individual or all notifications as read. Shows a loading spinner and empty state when appropriate.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Displays a user profile page with avatar, bio, badges, and uploaded reels, supporting both own-profile and viewed-profile modes. Own profile includes edit and reel deletion functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Provides a form for uploading video or photo reels with title, description, category, hashtags, and optional thumbnail. Handles file selection, upload progress tracking, and error feedback.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routing, with helpers for persisting values in sessionStorage and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the RevSpace frontend, extending the theme with custom fonts (Barlow/Barlow Condensed), oklch-based color tokens, neon shadows, and accordion keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the RevSpace flexDynoOS project, listing existing features, five pending new feature requests (dyno session manager, run comparison, tune version control, report generator, safety detection), and an active fix request for backend Motoko compilation errors causing deployment failures.
